name: Image action button
summary: The compact per-option image control — an image icon button with empty / loading / thumbnail states and a Change/Edit/Delete menu; it emits intents, the host owns the modals.
highlights: Empty, loading and thumbnail states with a Change, Edit, Delete menu
Emits intents; the host owns the modals
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-image-action-button> — the per-OPTION image control (SETTINGS-22/32). It is an image ICON button, never a text button labelled "Image". Three states: empty (an "Add image" icon button), loading (a spinner at the same size, no layout jump), and filled (the thumbnail with a hover pencil overlay that opens a Change / Edit / Delete menu). It OWNS no modals — it EMITS intents (`add` / `change` / `edit` / `delete`) and the host runs the upload/crop/confirm flow. Glyphs are summoned by name via <aha-icon>. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the outside-click listener is removed on disconnect.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. Wire the host to the intents; drive `state`/`src` from the host's upload flow. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: system-image-square glyph + "Add image" tooltip; click emits `add`

spec.label: Loading
spec.value: #E70E68 spinner at the same 36×36 size, 1px #E3E3E3 border — no layout jump; role=status, aria-label "Loading", aria-busy

spec.label: Filled
spec.value: 36×36 frame; the thumbnail (cover) and the hover pencil overlay (black @50%, white pencil) both fill its inner box with the inner radius 7, so they sit concentric with the frame; hover/focus #E70E68 border; click opens Change/Edit/Delete

spec.label: Menu
spec.value: Change / Edit / Delete (Delete in #1A1A1A); each emits an intent

spec.label: Intents
spec.value: add · change · edit · delete — host owns the modals, this owns none

spec.label: Tertiary variant
spec.value: variant=tertiary, the tertiary Button look on the empty and loading trigger: no border, no fill, #1A1A1A glyph at rest; hover and press #E70E680D fill (button-ghost-bg-hover / -press) with a #DB005B glyph (text-link-hover); disabled #B5B5B5 glyph, no fill. The filled thumbnail is unchanged

opinion.note: Per-option image support is all-or-nothing: present with its FULL state set, or the control is omitted entirely — never a disabled/greyed stub when unsupported (SETTINGS-22). It is a compact icon button, not a text "Image" button (SETTINGS-32). It emits intents; the host owns the upload/crop modals — never a self-built uploader.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab ImageActionButton control mapped into the DS. The icon button, overlay and menu reuse DS V3 tokens; the empty/loading/filled state machine + intent events are the settings-specific shape (SETTINGS-22/32).
